policy: Pre-production Brain schedulers are OFF by default. An ENABLED Brain scheduler must appear in `allowEnabled` with a named gate, a bounded monthly cost, a stop condition and the date it was approved (docs/brains/platform/SECTOR_BRAIN_MODEL_V1.md, PRE-PRODUCTION COST POLICY).

wind-hourly.gate: Wind live-reliability gate (30 valid live archive days) and timed provider-forecast archive
wind-hourly.stop: gate satisfied (about 2026-11-08) then re-decide, or the Wind validation campaign ends

lake-brain-ledger-daily.gate: Lake prospective prediction ledger (90 days PARTIAL, 12 months VALIDATED)
lake-brain-ledger-daily.stop: Michael's decision on the Lake validation campaign, or 12-month scoring complete

brain-orchestrator.gate: INTERNAL_OPERATION: hourly control plane that runs the internal Brain pipelines (Fish, Intelligence in-process; Water Temp, Clarity, Lake jobs when due; Depth/Vegetation SHADOW lane), scores, health and engineering status
brain-orchestrator.stop: pause the brain-orchestrator Cloud Scheduler job (gcloud scheduler jobs pause brain-orchestrator); owner decision ends internal operation
